summary: Hongli Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders to be held on June 5, 2026. The proposals include a share capital reorganization re-designating ordinary shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares, adoption of amended memorandum and articles of association, and a share capital reduction reducing par value from $0.0001 to $0.00001 per share. No transaction price, premium, or third-party involvement is disclosed. This is a routine corporate housekeeping matter—a meeting notice—not a special-situation event.
